verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a structured seller catalog feed: a CSV with one row per product or variant, plus pricing and inventory refreshed about every 15 minutes, which it shares with agents as "product, price, and availability information." Agent builders in embedded mode get "product feed ingestion" and product discovery, and Link CLI documents product search over UCP. However, that read access is private-preview, physical-goods-only, and gated per seller by OCA agreements that only sellers can initiate, so it does not cover "any listed product or service." Missing for 10: a documented developer-facing read API or schema for offer data, checkout links in the offer payload, open access beyond OCA-connected sellers, coverage of services, and hands-on corroboration.
